text:
Anya L.: Quick copy pass request for the 'Grant organization access' modal. Users are confused whether they're adding a person to a team or giving org-level permissions.
Maria (Design): I noticed that. The header says "Grant access" and the subcopy mentions "team" and "role" in the same sentence — ambiguity.
Jordan (PM): Goal: make intent explicit. This dialog is for granting org-level roles (Admin/Viewer) not team membership. Can we reword header and help text?
Sam (Eng): Also a11y note: the explanatory text is visually under the selector but not read by NVDA because it's not linked via aria-describedby to the select. We should add an id and reference it.
a11y-bot: Suggestion: header -> "Assign organization role"; help text -> "Select a role to grant at the organization level. This will not add the user to any team." Use aria-describedby on the role select.
Maria (Design): +1 for "Assign organization role". Alternative header: "Set organization permissions" — which feels action-oriented? Thoughts?
Anya L.: Prefer "Assign organization role" — clearer. Proposed subcopy: "Choose a role to grant across the organization. Team membership is managed separately under Teams." Short and scannable.
Jordan (PM): For buttons: primary should be "Assign role" and secondary "Cancel". Avoid "Grant" which sounds ambiguous.
Sam (Eng): Will do the aria-describedby. Also will ensure focus goes to the role select when modal opens: `document.getElementById('role-select').focus()`
Maria (Design): Microcopy nit for screen readers: change role labels from "Admin"/"Viewer" to full phrases in `aria-label` e.g., `aria-label="Organization Admin - full access"` so SR users get context.
a11y-bot: Recommend adding `aria-live="polite"` to the confirmation toast: "Role assigned to <name>" so it's announced.
Anya L.: Cool. Can someone push a small PR with copy + a11y changes? I can pair on wording in the PR description.
Sam (Eng): I'll open PR and tag you. ETA EOD.
Jordan (PM): Thanks — I'll update the product doc links. Small follow-up: add a link to "Manage teams" under the help text to reduce confusion.
Maria (Design): I'll add the link. Final copy for review in PR.
Anya L.: Awesome, thanks everyone :sparkles:
